comment: Contracts with Epstein means HAPPINESS! He knows how to teach. To pass Contracts with a decent grade youve to 1) attend his classes, 2) listen carefully and if you dont understand just ask, 3) do NOT ignore his practice questions, and finally consult his supplement Short and Happy Guide to Contracts. And enjoy learning Contracts with him.

Took 1L Contracts with Epstein.  He's amazing, although we all thought he was crazy at first.  Always do his "optional exams."  He gives feedback for exactly what he wants on the exam.  Don't sit in the front row because he spits, yells, and waves his hands.
